chars.NARRATOR: a 20-year-old Moroccan young man with short black curly hair and light stubble, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and black joggers
chars.SISTER: a Moroccan teenage girl about 18 with long dark wavy hair, wearing pink pajamas with white polka dots
chars.FRIEND: a Moroccan teenage girl about 18 with a short black bob haircut, wearing an oversized mint-green t-shirt and grey pajama pants
chars.BROTHER: a Moroccan boy about 8 years old with short hair, wearing a red striped sweater

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated illustration, night, a modest Moroccan bedroom in Meknes seen from the half-open doorway: FRIEND sits up wide awake in a single bed, staring back toward the door with a startled look, face clearly visible, head-to-waist framing, while SISTER sleeps right beside her under a blanket. Dim warm lamp light, patterned Moroccan blanket, calm dark edges, no text

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated illustration, night, dim Moroccan apartment hallway: NARRATOR stops in front of his sister's half-open bedroom door, peeking in with a surprised raised eyebrow, warm lamp light spilling out on his face, no text

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated illustration, night, close view of one narrow bed in a Moroccan bedroom: SISTER asleep and FRIEND lying very close next to her under the same patterned blanket, FRIEND's eyes open looking at the ceiling, soft blue moonlight from a window, no text

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated illustration, night, Moroccan bedroom doorway: FRIEND stands awkwardly holding her elbow, embarrassed shy smile, asking NARRATOR something; NARRATOR stands in the doorway listening, puzzled, both faces visible, warm lamp light, no text

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated illustration, night, Moroccan bedroom: NARRATOR lays a thin foam floor mattress with a folded blanket on the rug next to the bed and points to it, FRIEND watches holding a pillow, SISTER's shape asleep in the bed in the background, no text

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated illustration, early morning, small Moroccan kitchen with a teapot and bread on the table: NARRATOR with a backpack on one shoulder hurriedly pours tea, while BROTHER sits sleepy-eyed rubbing his eyes, morning light through the window, rushed energy, no text

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated illustration, morning, Moroccan apartment hallway near the front door: NARRATOR in a hurry tying his shoes and pulling BROTHER by the hand toward the door, BROTHER holding a school bag, the closed bedroom door of the sister visible behind them, no text

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated illustration, morning light, view over NARRATOR's shoulder from the doorway into the Moroccan bedroom: the thin floor mattress on the rug is empty with a crumpled blanket, and in the single bed SISTER and FRIEND sleep pressed close together; NARRATOR's face in profile shows shock and suspicion, no text
